fingerprint_policy.if_binary_readable: AI/tool automatically computes SHA-256 from actual image bytes.
fingerprint_policy.if_github_asset: Record Git blob SHA and compute SHA-256 when bytes are accessible.
fingerprint_policy.if_user_file_without_raw_hash_access: Use an immutable platform-provided file/attachment identifier as fingerprint if available. Never ask the user to manually calculate SHA.

revision_rules: Any actual image byte/content change requires manifest_revision+1.
For a changed page keep the stable asset_id, increment only that page's asset_revision, and generate a new fingerprint.
Unchanged pages preserve asset_id, asset_revision and fingerprint exactly.
Previous manifest files are immutable and must remain readable; never overwrite an old manifest revision.
R01 activates only one exact manifest path/id/revision in production current progress.
review_invalidation_rule: If a page asset_revision or fingerprint differs from the version cited by a review, that page-dependent review evidence is automatically STALE and cannot count toward a PASS barrier.
example_p3_only_revision: If P3 changes: manifest_revision+1; P3 asset_revision+1 and new fingerprint; P1/P2/P4/P5/P6 keep their previous asset revisions and fingerprints.
